test.summary: Box module - Gantt - Basic Operations - Creating Basic task without dates

steps.action: Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
steps.data: boxName: TC-4536 - Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - Creating Basic task without dates
steps.result:
Gantt module is displayed. 

Splash screen with informationis visible : 
"Fill your box with the first tasks

You can create them from scratch or define the scope to sync existing projects or boards."  

Below that information 2 tiles is visible: 

* "Create new" tile 
* "Define scope" tile

steps.action:
Click on Create new task tile -> Basic Task 

In Basic Task create task modal fill folLowing fields: Summary -> basicTask1 
Start Date/End Date -> leave empty
steps.result:
On WBS there is newly created basic task - "Basic Task One" 

No taskbar has been created on the Gantt chart.

steps.action: In column view switch Current view to newColumnView
steps.result:
New column view is visible on WBS. TC4536cv column view has 5 columns: 

* Icon 
* Key 
* Summary 
* Start Date (Built-in) 
* End Date (Built-in)

steps.action: Scroll Gantt chart to dateOne and set cursor on dateOne over row corresponding to basicTask1
steps.result:
While hovering over Gantt chart row corresponding to "Basic Task One" there is a grey placeholder (phantom task) with "+" sign inside. 

There are visible dates on the left and right side of the placeholder: 23.08.2023 for start date and end date. 

Start Date and End Date field in columns on WBS are empty.

steps.action: On Gantt chart hover over row corresponding to basicTask1 and move the cursor from dateOne to dateTwo
steps.data:
basicTask1: Basic Task One 
dateOne: 23.08.2023 
dateTwo: 29.08.2023
steps.result:
Placeholder is still visible while moving cursor over Gantt chart row. 

Now it has dates 29.08.2023 for Start Date (on the left side) and End Date (on the right side).

steps.action: Zoom in Gantt chart to maximum and scroll the chart to dateTwo. Hover over row corresponding to basicTask1 and move cursor over dateTwo.
steps.result:
Placeholder visible width has increased and is adjusted to the width of the cell containing the day in the timeline. 

There are visible dates on the left and right side of the placeholder: 29.08.2023 for start date and end date.

steps.action: In context menu click Create task -> Basic Task and add basicTask2
steps.result:
"Basic Task Two" is added on WBS. 
Start date and End date fields on WBS are empty. No taskbar for task is visible on Gantt chart.

steps.action: On Gantt chart hover over row corresponding to basicTask2 and move the cursor over dateThree
steps.result:
Placeholder is visible while moving cursor over Gantt chart row. 

It has dates 15.08.2023 for Start Date and End Date.

steps.action: Select basicTask1 on WBS and in context menu click Create task -> Create subtask -> Basic Task and add basicTaskChild
steps.data:
basicTask2: Basic Task One 
basicTaskChild: Basic Task Child
steps.result:
After selecting "Basic Task One" no snipe on Gantt chart is visible. 

"Basic Task Child" is added as a child task of "Basic Task One". Start date and End date fields on WBS are empty. No taskbar for child task is visible on Gantt chart.

steps.action: On Gantt chart hover over row corresponding to basicTaskChild
steps.result: Placeholder is visible while moving cursor over Gantt chart row.

Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-52 Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations
Labels: tc-tasks-no-dates, teamspace

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4536 - Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - Creating Basic task without dates
   Expected: Gantt module is displayed. 

Splash screen with informationis visible : 
"Fill your box with the first tasks

You can create them from scratch or define the scope to sync existing projects or boards."  

Below that information 2 tiles is visible: 

* "Create new" tile 
* "Define scope" tile
2. Click on Create new task tile -> Basic Task 

In Basic Task create task modal fill folLowing fields: Summary -> basicTask1 
Start Date/End Date -> leave empty
   Data: basicTask1: Basic Task One
   Expected: On WBS there is newly created basic task - "Basic Task One" 

No taskbar has been created on the Gantt chart.
3. In column view switch Current view to newColumnView
   Data: newColumnCV: TC4536cv
   Expected: New column view is visible on WBS. TC4536cv column view has 5 columns: 

* Icon 
* Key 
* Summary 
* Start Date (Built-in) 
* End Date (Built-in)

   Data: basicTask1: Basic Task One dateOne: 23.08.2023
   Expected: While hovering over Gantt chart row corresponding to "Basic Task One" there is a grey placeholder (phantom task) with "+" sign inside. 

There are visible dates on the left and right side of the placeholder: 23.08.2023 for start date and end date. 

Start Date and End Date field in columns on WBS are empty.
5. On Gantt chart hover over row corresponding to basicTask1 and move the cursor from dateOne to dateTwo
   Data: basicTask1: Basic Task One 
dateOne: 23.08.2023 
dateTwo: 29.08.2023

   Data: basicTask1: Basic Task One 
dateTwo: 29.08.2023

There are visible dates on the left and right side of the placeholder: 29.08.2023 for start date and end date.
7. In context menu click Create task -> Basic Task and add basicTask2
   Data: basicTask2: Basic Task Two
   Expected: "Basic Task Two" is added on WBS. 
Start date and End date fields on WBS are empty. No taskbar for task is visible on Gantt chart.
8. On Gantt chart hover over row corresponding to basicTask2 and move the cursor over dateThree
   Data: basicTask2: Basic Task Two 
dateThree: 15.08.2023
   Expected: Placeholder is visible while moving cursor over Gantt chart row. 

It has dates 15.08.2023 for Start Date and End Date.
9. Select basicTask1 on WBS and in context menu click Create task -> Create subtask -> Basic Task and add basicTaskChild
   Data: basicTask2: Basic Task One 
basicTaskChild: Basic Task Child
   Expected: After selecting "Basic Task One" no snipe on Gantt chart is visible.
